CORRECTEDZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT This Cqrrected Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement ("Corrected Agreement") August8,2003,byGRECOROMANREALTYCORP.,aNewYorkCorporationwithanoffice at 25-61 Steinway Street, Long Island City, NY, (hereinafter “Grantor") and G & L REALTY GROUP, LLC., a NewYork Corporation with an office at 47 Lee Avenue, Brooklyn, NewYork as Tenant in Common to the extent of75%,and TAFFE PLACE, LLC, having an address at 17 Keap Street, Brooklyn, NY 11211, as Tenant in Common to the extent of 25%(collectively hereinafter "Developer").
